observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large indoor hall with a wooden floor, a stage with a band at the back, and a crowd seated along the sides and back.
observation.dancers: A mixed group of around 15-20 men and women of various ages, dancing in a line and circle.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers start in a line holding hands, later forming a circle and moving around the floor counter-clockwise.
observation.posture: Upright posture with slight knee bends and weight shifting from foot to foot.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping side-to-side, hopping, and kicking or lifting knees on the beat; foot patterns include quick side steps and hops.
observation.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in a line/circle, arms extended at shoulder height or resting on adjacent dancers' shoulders.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright and stable while hips move with the stepping and hopping rhythm.
observation.partnering: Group dance with hand-to-hand and shoulder-to-shoulder contact in a line or circle, no individual couples partnering.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent small hops and knee lifts, no floor work or high jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual everyday clothing: jeans, shirts, sweaters, skirts, and boots.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement on the floor and fast micro-steps are partially occluded by camera movement and wide angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers in a line stepping sideways with synchronized knee lifts and hops.
Circle of dancers hopping and lifting knees together while holding hands outstretched.
Line breaking into a tighter circle with rapid hopping steps.
